Shubman Gill and Shafali Verma win ICC Player of the Month awards

Indian cricketers Shubman Gill and Shafali Verma have been named the ICC Players of the Month for September. This marks the fifth time players from the same national board have swept both the men's and women's awards, with Indian cricketers achieving this feat on two previous occasions. Gill received his fifth ICC award for his performance in an ODI series against West Indies, which included a double century. Verma secured her second monthly honor following standout performances in the Asia Cup, Asian Games, and the ODI series against West Indies.
